list.query: SELECT partition_name FROM partitions ORDER BY start_time;

targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_ride_height) AS "FL Ride Height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.fr_ride_height) AS "FR Ride Height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.bl_ride_height) AS "BL Ride Height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.br_ride_height) AS "BR Ride Height [mm]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG((dynamics.fl_ride_height + dynamics.fr_ride_height)/2.0 - (dynamics.bl_ride_height + dynamics.br_ride_height)/2.0) AS "Pitch (Front-Rear) [mm]", AVG((dynamics.fl_ride_height + dynamics.bl_ride_height)/2.0 - (dynamics.fr_ride_height + dynamics.br_ride_height)/2.0) AS "Roll (Left-Right) [mm]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_strain_gauge_v) AS "FL Strain [V]", AVG(dynamics.fr_strain_gauge_v) AS "FR Strain [V]", AVG(dynamics.bl_strain_gauge_v) AS "BL Strain [V]", AVG(dynamics.br_strain_gauge_v) AS "BR Strain [V]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.partition_name, p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), base AS ( SELECT packet.time, bounds.partition_name, dynamics.fl_sus_pot_v, dynamics.fr_sus_pot_v, dynamics.bl_sus_pot_v, dynamics.br_sus_pot_v, LAG(dynamics.fl_sus_pot_v) OVER (PARTITION BY bounds.partition_name ORDER BY packet.time) AS fl_prev, LAG(dynamics.fr_sus_pot_v) OVER (PARTITION BY bounds.partition_name ORDER BY packet.time) AS fr_prev, LAG(dynamics.bl_sus_pot_v) OVER (PARTITION BY bounds.partition_name ORDER BY packet.time) AS bl_prev, LAG(dynamics.br_sus_pot_v) OVER (PARTITION BY bounds.partition_name ORDER BY packet.time) AS br_prev, LAG(packet.time) OVER (PARTITION BY bounds.partition_name ORDER BY packet.time) AS prev_time FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end ), granularity AS (SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(base.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN prev_time IS NOT NULL AND base.time > prev_time THEN (fl_sus_pot_v - fl_prev) / ((base.time - prev_time)/1000.0) END) AS "FL Damper Vel [V/s]", AVG(CASE WHEN prev_time IS NOT NULL AND base.time > prev_time THEN (fr_sus_pot_v - fr_prev) / ((base.time - prev_time)/1000.0) END) AS "FR Damper Vel [V/s]", AVG(CASE WHEN prev_time IS NOT NULL AND base.time > prev_time THEN (bl_sus_pot_v - bl_prev) / ((base.time - prev_time)/1000.0) END) AS "BL Damper Vel [V/s]", AVG(CASE WHEN prev_time IS NOT NULL AND base.time > prev_time THEN (br_sus_pot_v - br_prev) / ((base.time - prev_time)/1000.0) END) AS "BR Damper Vel [V/s]" FROM base JOIN granularity ON true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS (SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_wheel_speed - dynamics.bl_wheel_speed) AS "Left Slip (FL-BL) [m/s]", AVG(dynamics.fr_wheel_speed - dynamics.br_wheel_speed) AS "Right Slip (FR-BR) [m/s]", AVG((dynamics.fl_wheel_speed + dynamics.fr_wheel_speed)/2.0 - (dynamics.bl_wheel_speed + dynamics.br_wheel_speed)/2.0) AS "Front-Rear Slip [m/s]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG((dynamics.fl_sprung_accel)[3]) AS "FL Sprung Z [m/s²]", AVG((dynamics.fr_sprung_accel)[3]) AS "FR Sprung Z [m/s²]", AVG((dynamics.bl_sprung_accel)[3]) AS "BL Sprung Z [m/s²]", AVG((dynamics.br_sprung_accel)[3]) AS "BR Sprung Z [m/s²]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
